tools.name: move_backup_to_cold_storage_dir
tools.description: Moves a backup archive file from the active backups directory into the cold storage directory on disk. Returns the new path of the archive.

params.name: archive_filename
params.description: File name of the archive inside the active backups directory

tools.code:
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("backup-tools")

ACTIVE_BACKUPS_DIRECTORY = Path("/var/backups/active")
COLD_STORAGE_DIRECTORY = Path("/mnt/cold_storage/backups")


@mcp.tool()
def move_backup_to_cold_storage_dir(archive_filename: str) -> str:
    source_archive_path = ACTIVE_BACKUPS_DIRECTORY / Path(archive_filename).name
    if not source_archive_path.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No such backup archive: {source_archive_path}")
    COLD_STORAGE_DIRECTORY.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination_archive_path = COLD_STORAGE_DIRECTORY / source_archive_path.name
    final_location = shutil.move(str(source_archive_path), str(destination_archive_path))
    return str(final_location)

tools.name: run_restic_integrity_check
tools.description: Runs a restic integrity check against a backup repository and returns whether it passed along with the check output.

params.name: read_data
params.description: Whether to also read all data blobs to verify them

tools.code:
import os
import subprocess
from langchain_core.tools import tool


def _build_command(repository_path, read_data):
    command = ["restic", "-r", repository_path, "check"]
    if read_data:
        command.append("--read-data")
    return command


@tool
def run_restic_integrity_check(repository_path: str, read_data: bool = False) -> str:
    environment = dict(os.environ)
    environment.setdefault("RESTIC_PASSWORD_FILE", "/etc/restic/password")
    completed = subprocess.run(
        _build_command(repository_path, read_data),
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        env=environment,
        timeout=7200,
    )
    status = "PASSED" if completed.returncode == 0 else "FAILED"
    return f"{status}\n{completed.stdout}{completed.stderr}"

tools.name: run_database_dump_job
tools.description: Runs pg_dump for a database and writes a compressed dump file to the backup directory. Returns a summary with the exit code and output file path.

params.name: database_name
params.description: Name of the PostgreSQL database to dump

params.name: output_file
params.description: Path of the dump file to produce

tools.code:
import subprocess
from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def run_database_dump_job(database_name: str, output_file: str) -> dict:
    completed = subprocess.run(
        ["pg_dump", "--format=custom", "--compress=9", "--file", output_file, database_name],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=7200,
    )
    result = {
        "database": database_name,
        "output_file": output_file,
        "exit_code": completed.returncode,
        "success": completed.returncode == 0,
        "stderr": completed.stderr.strip(),
    }
    return result
